description.value: The study examined sex-based differences in behavioral and neuronal responses to food-related visual stimuli in healthy women and men after controlled feeding.

spans.text: The present study was performed to examine sex-based differences in appetitive behavior as well as in the neuronal response to food-related visual cues.
